en: We've probably met several hundred times, but... I suppose if I got shot as much as you did just now, I wouldn't remember how to chew my own food.
It's alright, this'll pass. Slight memory loss isn't totally uncommon when someone's suffered enough physical trauma.
Just so we're covering all of our bases. . .
{AngryB} I can't "take it easy." I have to--[getting a headache]mph... I have to find Crane.
Lack of sleep, for one thing. Getting shot for another.[beat] He'll be fine.
{WorriedA} Bigby? What's wrong?
Yes, everyone.
How's everyone else who was at the funeral? They all make it?
Snow, are you okay?
{WorriedA} Is she?
She's fine, Bigby.
{WorriedA} Are you okay?
[weakly] {NormalA} Yeah, I'm good.
Nothing a little stitching couldn't patch up.
I had to figure out the faucets first, but I just thought he could use some water.
Thanks for the water.
Did you "figure out" the toilet?
You're still here?
Colin's been, uh, dutifully watching over you.
He was here when we got back.
[annoyed] I thought you went to use the restroom.
I did. I did that, too.
I told everyone we should shower you.
Or a rag, at least.
[sighs] Just what I wanted right now. Thanks.
I'm less concerned with the faucets and more with you "figuring out" the toilet.
Hey, I used to be a home owner, asswipe. Remember that?[beat] I know how to work a fuckin' throne.
[complete lie] Noooo.
I heard my good pal Bigby was in trouble, so. . . I came back to "assist" you.[beat] Like a helper monkey.
[disbelieving] Really. You came back.
You mean you haven't been here for the last three days?
What are you still doing here?
[cordially saying goodbye] Swiney.
[cordially saying goodbye] Miss White.[beat] Bigby.
Well, I'll leave you two to it, then.
Just remember what I said. The stitches won't hold up if you continue to act...
[dull acceptance] Yeah.
[casually numb] So. . . Crane's gone.
[depressed] Yeah.
[depressed] I figured.
The Magic Mirror's been smashed. Bufkin said he saw Crane do it. . . before he left.[beat] Bufkin's trying to fix it.
Just wait for the mirror?
Crane's getting away.
Any other leads?
[quietly; almost to herself] {WorriedA} Once he puts all the pieces back together... it'll be easy to catch Crane.
[sigh] {WorriedA} So... I guess that's the plan.
[tired] {SadA} Currently.
[tiredly to herself] {SadA} But I don't know...
[annoyed] {ThinkingB} That's the plan? Just wait for the mirror?
[cold] {NormalA} It's all we have right now.
{FlusteredB} Well, I don't want to just go running off into the night without some direction.
{ThinkingB} We don't have time to wait for the mirror. Crane could be getting on a train right now.
{ThinkingB} There's no other leads?[beat] This is it? Just wait for the mirror.
[bitter] We thought you could be dead or dying, so... we had to make some decisions without you.
I had everyone that got wounded sent home.
The, um, Tweedles
That includes the surviving Tweedle. "House arrest," for lack of a better phrase.
And that includes the Tweedles. "House arrest," for lack of a better phrase.
It's okay,Bigby.
I've been assured he's being watched.
I've been assured they're being watched.
Because nobody seems to want to tell me anything.
Yeah, and. . . speaking of Crane. . . what did he do exactly?
To what rights are you possibly referring?
How bout the right of friendship.
[Referencing Snow] Particularly your little sweetheart over there.
You're not even supposed to be here, Colin.
I got more rights to be here than you.
Snow doesn't want you to know, so. . .
You don't need to know.
Crane's the prime suspect in those murders.
Go for "a walk?" I'm not a fuckin' dog.
Snow's right. You're not supposed to be here. And she and I have stuff to talk about.
If Snow hasn't told you, then she doesn't want you to know, so. . .
Yeah, I don't need to know but I wanna know.
I mean, I've been here for two hours watching whatever it is I "don't need to know" keep you on your ass.
So what's going on?
You don't need to know, so just. . . don't let it concern you.
It's nothing.
Bigby, c'mon.
No shit?
[depressed] Yeah.[beat] No shit.
You know those murders that have been going on?
I don't want everyone--[stops herself; super annoyed; sighs] Fine.
Yeah, and I won't say anything in the meantime.
[exasperated] Oh my God. You just don't need to know.
Well. . . as of right now, Crane's the prime suspect.
We should get back to the Business Office anyway.
It's kind of personal between her and Crane, okay?
Okay, alright, well that's all you had to say.
Yeah, so? So what?
This is gonna come out at some point.
[petulant] Whatever.
[muttered to himself] You always have a way with guests, don't you.
[muttered to himself] Keep your stupid secrets.
[pointed] We need to talk about what happened tonight. At the funeral.
What I do know is that... we are a lawful community.[beat] And this is not the old days.
And the Tweedle brothers were bad guys, and a part of me thinks they deserved what they got... a very old part of me.
I'm not gonna jump up and down, I'm not gonna scream, I'm not gonna... tear out my hair, you know, what's done is done.
You don't kill somebody because you feel like it.
You had a hundred ways to solve that.
And you chose the one way that you can't walk back.
And, Bigby, what you did tonight... was reprehensible.
A hundred ways to make it right...
It was the only way.
I'm not gonna see you hurt.
You're right.
It was the only way. And if you don't see that. . . I'm sorry. But I'm not sorry for what I did.
I'm not gonna see you hurt, Snow. I'm just not.
I regret it.[beat] Alright? I regret it, I do.
We all have to live with it. All of us, the whole town.
Okay, Snow, lay off him, will ya? He's the one that has to live with it.
I don't know that you do.
Okay, Snow, you've made your point. Lay off him, will ya? He's the one who has to live with it.
This town is going to eat itself if Bigby and I don't show them through our own actions that the old ways aren't acceptable anymore!
Oh, like anyone is gonna give a shit that two psychos with shotguns attacked a troll funeral and one of them got killed!
I mean, is this justice to you?
It's exactly this kind of acceptance that I won't tolerate, Colin.
Do you even care how the town will react to this?
Because it's important that we figure this out, right now...
Was tonight justice?
So that... [quieter] so that I know I can even trust you.
I thought it was.
Yes, it was.
I didn't have time to really think about it. . .
Don't lecture me.
[quietly] And some of us still think it was.
I thought it was. At the time.
[bitter] I didn't have time to really think about it. I didn't have that luxury.
[sighs, then quieter] It was just about trying to help.
[softer] It wasn't about justice. It was about...
[a little pissed] Don't lecture me, Snow.[beat] You were there, you know how bad it could have gotten.
[cold] It was over before you broke his neck.[beat] Don't lie to yourself, too.
[quietly] Some of us think it was justice.
Yes. It was.
But still...
[plainly] {NormalA} Thanks for tonight, by the way.
Not too bad.
Did you get hurt?
Things must have been moving fast for, uh, for that to happen.
[shut up] Colin.
No, I wasn't there, I don't know.
Or, you know... for you to allow that to happen.
It's why I'm askin'.
So... I wouldn't kick you out of a fox hole, alright?
But... it did. And since it did, I just wanna get on the record... I'm glad you were there.
Any time.
Well... not everything.[beat] I mean, the Tweedles are still alive, aren't they?
{NormalA} Any time.
So... I mean just opportunistically speaking, something was left on the table, wasn't it?
I feel bad for Holly.
I'm not pushing, I'm just trying to figure out what happened, that's all.
It's just surprising... considering what happened.
Fuck you. You don't know what happened, so don't push it with me right now.
I mean, the Tweedles are still alive, aren't they?
The Tweedles got away.
Yeah, I've learned my lesson.[beat; then growling almost just to himself] I won't be so nice next time.
Yeah, but, you know... the Tweedles are still alive, aren't they?
I think you were plenty mean enough.
Colin, just leave it alone.
It's just surprising. . . considering what happened.
The government-- we have immense powers and we have to wield them responsibly.
That is never on the table with us.
Yeah, but that's the thing, Snow... Bigby doesn't think like that. I know he doesn't.
This... guy you know, it's all just pretend.
It's been a long time since we ate each other's hearts. We can't always be gladiators.
He gets it out in little ways. Treating me like shit, for one.
And I'm not saying he's an asshole. He's not... at least not to me.
But if there was even a second's thought that this whole village would go under tomorrow... if there were no consequences...
He'd be ripping the heads off of every cabbie who ever gave him a dirty look before you could say, "Please don't."
Shut the fuck up, Colin.
That's not who I am anymore.
Don't listen to him.
[quietly] Anyways.[beat] It was just a surprise.
Colin. Shut the fuck up.
I like the city, I like civilization. I'm not "pretending" to be anything.
Just don't listen to him, alright?
This is who I am.
That's not who I am anymore, okay?
Oh. Sorry.
Vivian?
[awkward] Hi! Right. From the funeral. Snow. I'm-- I'm sorry... is the, um, the Sheriff in there?
It's probably Bufkin.
I just, um... could I just have a moment to speak with you?
I'd just... I'd love just a minute of your time.
Colin has to stay here and I should go check on the mirror and see if Bufkin's done yet.
I'm sorry, it's just... I'd love just a minute of your time.
I'm busy right now.
[quietly to Bigby] We still have to do our jobs. I dealt with her all the time about Crane... she could know something.
I'm just wondering.
[to Colin] Don't touch anything.
I'll let you know, you know... when I know.
What are you sorry for?
It's okay. . .
What happened. . . It's not your fault.
Um. . .
I know it's not your fault.
Why say anything now?
And. . . and. . .
[to herself, quietly] Shit.
[sad] I can't say it to the person I really want to.
I don't have many friends outside of. . . work.
Just, do me a favor, and. . . please don't tell Snow that I knew what was going on.
It's stupid, but. . . she's a good person.
[sigh] I'd just hate to have her hate me.
What's in it for me?
I can't hide things from her.
Just give us a minute.
[quietly stern] We're about out of minutes, if you get my drift.
I have an office for a reason. Knock next time.
[quietly excited] Thanks. Thanks, Bigby.
I understand. I won't saying anything.
I'll make a deal with you. We can leave Snow out of it, if you give me some information.
Uh. . . sure.[beat] I mean, because of my, erm, condition, I don't know how much use I'll be.
No, no, I understand.
I'm sorry, but while I appreciate you coming down here, this is still an ongoing investigation.[beat] I can't hide things from her.
And. . . I hope at least that it helps in some way.
And. . . I hope that this at least helps in some way.
I understand, of course, if you do tell her.
And I, uh, I guess that's it.
[plain] Unless there's something else you want.
Actually, while you're here, I do have some questions.
Are you gonna be alright?
Be careful out there.
Are you. . . gonna be alright out there?
Just be careful out there.
Anything about Crane would help.
[sighs] Talking with her. . . her setting up his "visits". . . it made me feel awful.
Uh, account? Girl? Room?
Just. . . anything about Crane. Anything at all would be a big help.
And I really only spoke with Snow on the phone.[beat] It's part of the reason I came in.
I don't know. He, uh, rarely came in. . . I think it was just the one time to "set up" his. . . you know.
Just tell me what you can.
What can't you talk about?
Then just say what you can. Anything and everything that could be useful.
It'd just solidify what you already know.
[a little cold] He's a scumbag pervert. The end.
There's nothing much, really. I don't. . .[finding the word]
It'd be too hard without. . . reference or something, and there's nothing about him that I think you'd care to learn at this point.
[quietly] A lot of migraines.
Anything our "clients" wouldn't want anyone else to know. Either out of embarrassment, or. . . dodging certain "legalities."
We can sometimes get around it. . . God and magic do have their loop holes. But not often enough and it hurts to try.
What can't you talk about, anyway?
It wasn't your fault, dear.
I'm sorry.[beat] About everything.
And Snow?
So what did she want?
Did she ask about Crane?
Did she know anything?
Nothing?
Don't fly off the handle.
What did Vivian want?
The mirror!
This isn't trivial, Snow.
They only thing we know is that Crane called somebody before he ran out.
[just as fed up] I don't know. He saw us come in and he's refused to leave.
First, why the fuck is Bluebeard here?
Because this shit throwing silversmith can't finish the job!
I mean, nobody's that nervous without having a reason.
Well I never trusted the nerdy prick.
He always looked like he had something to hide.
{NormalA} Thanks to me.
[quietly] Do he really think he killed those women?
Holly took Lily's stuff with her when she left the funeral.
There could be something there you can use.[beat] Against him.
Holly took Lily's stuff back with when she left the funeral. I know trolls like to, um, burn everything, but. . .
It might have info about whoever Crane was using to make the, uh, the glamour.
Vivian told me that Holly has Lily's stuff, still.
Okay, well. . . that's something.
Crane wasn't in the Business Office.
Ichabod wasn't here.
[sigh; depressed] Yeah.
[quietly] I dealt with her all the time about Crane. . . she could know something.
I don't know. What's in for me?
Look, I really do want to help, but. . . I dunno.
We don't know!
It'll be seen as stealing from the commonwealth for her own personal vendettas.
"Temporary holiday" or whatever the Hell you wanna call it, I don't care, but that way nothing gets miscontrued while we sort this stuff out.
I think she wanted me to know that there's possibly information there about whoever made your glamour.
No! If Bigby's checking Crane's apartment, I'll go to the Tweedles. It makes the most sense if we split up.
